name: site2md
solution: `build` converts the page, `extract` runs a minimal Extractor written for this benchmark, and one last step writes the record values. The crawl runs `build` in site mode with `--max-pages 20 --max-depth 2` and reuses the same Extractor across the document's source sections. Both commands run in their opt-in fast modes, `build --no-progress` and `extract --entry-points-only`. site2md is installed from its release tag, because the PyPI name belongs to a different project.
